pages.text: Right-click mobs to extract life samples.$(li)Right-click life blocks/pipes to charge$(li)Weaker mobs yield higher success (+10% at half HP, +10% at quarter, cap 95%)$(li)Purity: 60% chance 0-49, 25% 50-74, 15% 75-100
The Analyzer breaks samples of purity >=25 into gene sequences: 5000 Life Energy, 5 seconds; success scales with purity (25->70%, 100->95%), failure loses the sample.
Gene sequences keep the sample purity and build organs in the Life Struct.$(br)Purity drives sequence purity -> organ completeness -> rejection correction.
